# Chimera II OS — Publication Accounts & Authentication

## Approved identities

- Primary technical / Chimera publication: `amer.hwaitat@gmail.com`
- News / media / Arabic-Hebrew publication: `news.hebrew.arabic@gmail.com`

These are the approved identities for publication. An email address alone does not authorize third-party writes. No password, recovery code, API secret, or OAuth token is stored in the repository.

## YouTube

Use the primary identity for technical Chimera II OS videos and the news/media identity for news-oriented material where appropriate.

The YouTube Data API requires an authenticated OAuth 2.0 authorization for upload operations, including the `youtube.upload` scope. The upload request can set title, description, tags, category and privacy state. Unverified API projects created after July 28, 2020 can have uploaded videos restricted to private until the project passes Google's audit requirements.

Publication state: **Approved / awaiting account authorization**.

## WordPress

Use the approved identities according to the site/account owner configuration. WPWriter is installed and available in ChatGPT, but no WordPress site is currently connected.

After a user-controlled WordPress site is connected, the planned content includes:

1. Chimera II OS — Official Overview
2. Chimera II OS Development Vlog
3. Chimera II OS Architecture
4. Chimera ISA & CPU Research
5. 128D Framework & Multidimensional Computing
6. Repository & Documentation Index

The WordPress REST API supports posts, tags, media and comments. Authenticated write operations require appropriate authorization.

Publication state: **Approved / awaiting a user-controlled WordPress site URL and authorization**.

## Search engines

The GitHub Pages portal already contains crawler-oriented metadata, a same-site sitemap and `robots.txt`. Search-engine discovery is ready, but direct webmaster submissions require authenticated ownership of the relevant property. There is no universal operation that can force indexing across every search engine.

## Video hosts

Approved target: YouTube plus legitimate free/low-cost video hosts that the owner explicitly authorizes.

The current Library media manifest is maintained in `docs/PUBLICATION_AND_MEDIA_DISTRIBUTION.md`. Destination URLs are recorded only after successful authenticated publication.

## Comments

No automated bulk promotional commenting on unrelated videos. Community comments should be relevant, short, truthful, non-repetitive and point to the canonical Chimera II OS source only when appropriate.

## Publication rule

A destination is marked **Published** only when an authenticated write succeeds and a retrievable public URL is available. Intended URLs, search previews and planned destinations are not publication evidence.
